name: esc-action
description: GitHub Action to install the ESC CLI and inject environment variables from an ESC environment.

version.description: Version of ESC CLI to install. If omitted, installs the latest.

environment.description: The ESC environment to pull environment variables from.

keys.description: A comma-separated list of specific keys to inject from within the ESC values.environmentVariables object. E.g. "NPM_TOKEN,SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL".

cloud-url.description: The URL of the Pulumi Cloud API. Defaults to https://api.pulumi.com.

export-environment-variables.description: Whether or not to export environment variables. All environment variables will always be available in the 'env' step output.

oidc-auth.description: When true, the ESC action will exchange the GitHub workflow OIDC token for a Pulumi Access Token. Requires id-token: write permission.

oidc-organization.description: The name of the Pulumi organization to use for OIDC token exchange. Required if oidc-auth is true.

oidc-requested-token-type.description: The type of Pulumi Access Token to obtain. Required if oidc-auth is true.

oidc-scope.description: The requested scopes for the Pulumi Access Token.

oidc-token-expiration.description: The time-to-live for the Pulumi Access Token.
